cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: Tennessee General Assembly, bill information SB0781 (112th General Assembly): Public Chapter 597, signed Feb. 8, 2022

Splits Davidson County three ways; used in 2022 and 2024. Census file basis: the Bureau documents its 2022 legislative files as the plans collected for the 2022 election year, and the 118th Congress files as the plans the states submitted for that Congress. Compared on documents only: the cached Census folder held only the 2024 vintage when this was checked, so the 2020 and 2022 files were not opened.
